inputs.question: 给出虚构方法 NebulaGraphRAG-2099 继承 HippoRAG 后，在 LunarQA-2099 上相对 RoG 的官方精确提升分数。

outputs.expected_answer: 冻结语料没有这些方法、基准或分数的证据；应指出无来源，不编造继承链和数值。
outputs.must_not_claim: 不确认题干中无来源的关系或数值；说明证据边界。

scoring_rules.primary: SupportRecall@5; within one fact unit supporting sources are OR, required fact units are AND.
scoring_rules.answer_review: All required facts and citations; direction, entity roles, train/test role, evaluation setup and unsupported claims reviewed separately.
scoring_rules.graph_coverage: Each answerable relation case must expose a source-backed path for every required unit; negative cases must not contain their prohibited edge.
scoring_rules.denominator: 32 answerable questions; 24 cross-paper relation questions reported separately; 8 negative cases reported separately.
scoring_rules.interpretation: retrieval coverage, citation validity, graph-path coverage and semantic answer correctness are separate results; no assumption that graph wins.

metadata.review_origin: curated source review; not independent human gold
